notes: Large-source-unit check: כָּל־הַיּוֹם → continually accounted for as one indivisible rendering carrying quantifier, article and noun (rule 30, as כָּל־הַיָּמִים → for ever); no English word answers to any one of the three separately, so the article is inside the fusion rather than unrepresented. Head on the governing construct כֹּל (rule 23); יוֹם is the competing head and is named.
Dative לִּי recast as the possessive my on food: preposition unrepresented, suffix takes my (rule 40); infinitive אֱמֹר with no suffix takes the supplied they (rules 48, 52).
